text: The first real close surfaces a problem -- Cost Center 100 is carrying freight and utility costs no Corporate activity explains.
Simone Alvarez notices the three real warehouses look suspiciously light while Corporate looks suspiciously heavy, and brings it to Theo.
Theo traces a sample of invoices and checks the distribution lines themselves -- the Accounts Payable team entered every Cost Center correctly.
The real cause is the Subledger Accounting rule: it reads the Cost Center from a purchase order attribute that's always blank on these invoices, and defaults to 100 every time.
Forty-seven invoices, $382,900, all misrouted the same way. Diagnosed -- now it has to be fixed.
